annotations.title: How much of a dividend to give to charity

description: How much of a dividend to give to charity. Returns the company's purification ratio (interest income over total revenue, from its latest 10-K that reports interest income; 'latest_annual_filing' and 'note' say when that is older than the latest 10-K) and, if a dividend amount is given, the amount to give to charity. For a company whose main business every standard excludes, 'business_screen' explains that purification does not make it permissible.

dividend.description: The dividend received, in any currency.
